mainEntity.name: How do I determine if my property is suitable for an ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: To determine if your property is suitable for an ADU, several factors are considered, including lot size, current zoning regulations, available space for setbacks, and access to utilities. It's also important to assess the structural integrity of existing buildings if considering an attached or conversion ADU, and to understand soil conditions. Hometelligent Inc. offers initial site evaluations to assess feasibility and identify potential challenges or opportunities specific to your parcel, ensuring a realistic project scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: Property suitability for an ADU depends on lot size, zoning, setbacks, utility access, and existing structure integrity. Site evaluations help confirm feasibility.
